overall_rationale: The overall verdict is not_feasible because must need N2 (mapping of product codes across the April 2024 code change) is unmet. No candidate provides a mapping. The wiki says none exists, and the product list covers only current codes, so the history window cannot be joined on product_code. The other must needs are met with conditions: N1 via the restricted sales table (access from Retail Operations), and N3 via Open-Meteo (Legal sign-off on mixed licences, shop location confirmed, full-window coverage checked). N2 can be unblocked if Retail Operations produces a retired-code mapping, which would be a new source to assess. Should needs N4 (Nager holidays, data licence to be established) and N5 (shop calendar, to be profiled) are feasible with conditions. Attribution text for Open-Meteo ('Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, with a link to https://open-meteo.com/') should appear in outputs as an action. Manual export steps are not needed; all sources are programmatic.
